questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the recent inclusion of Ramsar Wetland Sites in India: (**as of June 2025**)

1. India has added two new wetlands—Khichan (Phalodi) and Menar (Udaipur), both in Rajasthan, raising the country’s total Ramsar sites to 91.

2. India holds the highest number of Ramsar sites in Asia and ranks third globally, after the United Kingdom and Mexico.

Which of the above statements is/are ***CORRECT***?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 2 only.

__
 
• **Statement 1 is correct**: The two most recently designated Ramsar sites in India are Khichan (Phalodi) and Menar (Udaipur)** **in **Rajasthan (As of June 2025).**
 
• **Statement 2 is correct** as India holds the highest number of Ramsar sites in Asia and ranks third globally, after the United Kingdom and Mexico.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **In News__**

__
 
• The two most recently designated Ramsar sites in India are Gokul Jalashay and Udaipur Jheel in Bihar, both added in September 2025. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Khichan (Phalodi):** A critical site for avian biodiversity, particularly for migratory Demoiselle cranes.
 
• **Menar (Udaipur):** Known for its community-led bird conservation efforts, often referred to as "Bird Village."
 
• **Ramsar Sites in India:** India now has the highest number of Ramsar sites in Asia, demonstrating its strong commitment to wetland conservation and biodiversity protection.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ramsar Convention:** An international treaty adopted in 1971 to conserve and wisely use wetlands. India became a party to this convention in 1982.
 
• **Global Ranking:** India ranks third globally in terms of Ramsar sites, after the United Kingdom and Mexico.

questions.question: Which countries will co-host the 2026 Rugby League World Cup?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Australia and Papua New Guinea**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 2026 Rugby League World Cup is set to be co-hosted by **Australia** and **Papua New Guinea**.
 
• Australia has a rich rugby league heritage, being one of the strongest nations in the sport globally.
 
• Papua New Guinea is the only country where rugby league is the national sport, showcasing its popularity and significance.
 
• The decision to co-host the event with Papua New Guinea aims to promote the sport further in the Pacific region.
 
• Rugby League World Cups are held every four years, and the 2026 edition will follow the tournament hosted by France in 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rugby League World Cup:**

 
 
• The Rugby League World Cup is an international tournament first held in 1954, making it one of the oldest competitions in rugby.
 
• It is organized by the International Rugby League (IRL).
 
• The tournament features teams from across the globe, including Tier 1 nations and emerging rugby league nations.
 
• The format includes men's, women's, and wheelchair rugby league competitions.
 
 
 
• **Australia’s Rugby League Legacy:**
 
 
• Australia has won the Rugby League World Cup a record 11 times, solidifying its dominance in the sport.
 
• The National Rugby League (NRL) in Australia is one of the most competitive rugby league competitions in the world.
 
 
 
• **Papua New Guinea and Rugby League:**
 
 
• Rugby league is the most popular sport in Papua New Guinea, with a significant following at grassroots and professional levels.
 
• The Papua New Guinea national team, known as the Kumuls, is a competitive force in international rugby league.
 
 
 
• **Regional Development of Rugby League:**
 
 
• The co-hosting decision aims to boost rugby league infrastructure and participation in the Pacific region.
 
• It reflects the sport's commitment to expanding its reach beyond traditional strongholds.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Kerala tops the Management Effectiveness Evaluation of national parks and protected areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Kerala** ranked **first** in the **Management Effectiveness Evaluation (MEE) 2020–2025**, conducted by the **Union Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change**.

 
 
• 
 
It was the **only state** to receive a **"Very Good" rating**, with a **score of 76.22%**.

 
 
• 
 
**Karnataka (74.24%)**, **Punjab (71.74%)**, and **Himachal Pradesh (71.36%)** received a **"Good" rating**.

 
 
• 
 
**Eravikulam National Park**, located in **Munnar, Kerala**, was ranked **best among all national parks in India**, scoring **92.97%**, **sharing the top rank with Dachigam National Park** in **Jammu & Kashmir**.

 
 
• 
 
The **MEE** was conducted across **438 Protected Areas**, based on **IUCN and WCPA global criteria**.

 
 
• 
 
**Eravikulam National Park** (97 sq.km) lies in the **Western Ghats’ shola-grassland ecosystem**.

 
 
• 
 
It hosts the **largest population of Nilgiri Tahr** (an **endangered** species).

 
 
• 
 
It's also famous for the **kurinji flowers (Strobilanthes kunthianus)**, which **bloom once every 12 years**.

**Chenab Bridge**, the world’s highest railway arch bridge (359 m above river), inaugurated by PM Modi in J&K.

• 
 
Foundation stone laid for **Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Institute of Medical Excellence** in Katra (₹350 crore), first medical college in Reasi district.

questions.question: India’s First Wildlife Corridor Built on Delhi-Mumbai Highway Near ___________ Wildlife Sanctuary.
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Ranthambore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India’s First Wildlife Corridor Built on Delhi-Mumbai Highway Near Ranthambore Wildlife Sanctuary.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**NHAI** (National Highways Authority of India) has created **India’s first dedicated wildlife corridor** on a **national highway**.

 
 
• 
 
It is a **12-km stretch** on the **Delhi-Mumbai Expressway**.

 
 
• 
 
The corridor passes through the **buffer zone** of **Ranthambore Tiger Reserve**.

 
 
• 
 
Features include **five wildlife overpasses** and **India’s longest underpass** built **exclusively for animal movement**.

 
 
• 
 
This is the **first expressway in India** designed to **balance human travel and wildlife protection**.

 
 
• 
 
The project was developed with input from the **Wildlife Institute of India** and the **Ministry of Environment and Forests**.

 
 
• 
 
It connects the **Ranthambore and Chambal Valley**, which is rich in biodiversity including **tigers, leopards, bears**, and **other endangered species**.

questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Rs 3,000**__.

• 
 
**Nitin Gadkari** announced an **annual FASTag pass** for **private vehicles**.

 
 
• 
 
The pass will cost **₹3,000** and is valid for **1 year or 200 trips**, whichever comes first.

questions.question: Who has been appointed Chairman of the Economic Advisory Council to the Prime Minister (EAC-PM)? (June 2025)
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**S. Mahendra Dev**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• S Mahendra Dev Appointed New Chief of EAC-PM.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**S. Mahendra Dev** has been appointed as **Chairman of the Economic Advisory Council to the Prime Minister (EAC-PM)**.

 
 
• 
 
He **resigned** as **independent director of Axis Bank** after this appointment.

 
 
• 
 
**Suman Bery**, Vice-Chairman of **NITI Aayog**, currently **heads EAC-PM**.

 
 
• 
 
Dev is an **expert in agriculture and rural economy**.

 
 
• 
 
He is **editor** of *Economic and Political Weekly* and **chairs** the **Institute for Development Studies**, Andhra Pradesh.

 
 
• 
 
Former **Director of Indira Gandhi Institute of Development Research (IGIDR)**.

 
 
• 
 
Holds a **PhD from Delhi School of Economics** and did **post-doc at Yale University**.

 
 
• 
 
**EAC-PM** is an **independent body** that **advises the PM on economic and policy issues**.

 
 
• 
 
Functions include: **analyzing macroeconomic issues**, **providing advice**, and **undertaking tasks** referred by the PM.
